question: 查询今年华东区域各月的销售额和订单数
expected_result_notes: 按月份升序返回 12 行，每月一行；销售额为有效订单金额之和，订单数为有效订单数量。
golden_sql: SELECT to_char(o.created_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, r.name AS region_name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_regions AS r ON r.id = o.region_id WHERE r.name = '华东' AND o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY to_char(o.created_at, 'YYYY-MM'), r.name ORDER BY to_char(o.created_at, 'YYYY-MM')

question: 统计今年各区域的订单数和总销售额，按销售额从高到低排列
expected_result_notes: 每个区域一行，按销售额降序；订单数为去重后的订单数量。
golden_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, COUNT(o.id) AS orders, SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_regions AS r ON r.id = o.region_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC

question: 对比今年华东和华南各商品类别的销售额
expected_result_notes: 华东与华南两个区域，按商品类别分别汇总销售额。
golden_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, p.category AS category, SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_regions AS r ON r.id = o.region_id JOIN analytics.demo_products AS p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND r.name IN ('华东', '华南') AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY r.name, p.category ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC

question: 查询不存在的区域去年的销售额
expected_result_notes: 结果必须为空。
golden_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_regions AS r ON r.id = o.region_id WHERE r.name = '不存在的区域' AND o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY r.name

question: 查询今年各区域的销售额
expected_result_notes: 今年每个区域一行，结果必须非空。
golden_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_regions AS r ON r.id = o.region_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC

question: 查询今年华东区域智能手表的销售额
expected_result_notes: 只返回华东区域智能手表在今年的销售额。
golden_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, p.name AS product, SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_regions AS r ON r.id = o.region_id JOIN analytics.demo_products AS p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE r.name = '华东' AND p.name = '智能手表' AND o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY r.name, p.name

question: 统计今年各区域的订单数
expected_result_notes: 今年每个区域恰好一行，区域和订单数列必须存在。
golden_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, COUNT(o.id) AS orders FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_regions AS r ON r.id = o.region_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY COUNT(o.id) DESC

question: 对比今年与去年各区域的销售额
expected_result_notes: 每个区域一行，包含今年和去年两列销售额。
golden_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_this_year, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1 THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_last_year FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_regions AS r ON r.id = o.region_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY r.name

question: 查询今年各商品类别的订单数
expected_result_notes: 每个商品类别一行，订单数为有效订单数量。
golden_sql: SELECT p.category AS category, COUNT(o.id) AS orders FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_products AS p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY COUNT(o.id) DESC

question: 查询今年各月的订单数
expected_result_notes: 按月返回 12 行，每月订单数非空。
golden_sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(o.created_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(o.created_at, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(o.created_at, 'YYYY-MM')

question: 查询今年第一季度华东区域的销售额
expected_result_notes: 返回今年前三个月华东区域的销售额。
golden_sql: SELECT SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_regions AS r ON r.id = o.region_id WHERE r.name = '华东' AND o.status = 'paid' AND o.created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) AND o.created_at < DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '3 months'

question: 统计今年各商品类别的销售额和订单数
expected_result_notes: 每个商品类别一行，按销售额降序。
golden_sql: SELECT p.category AS category, SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales, COUNT(o.id) AS orders FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_products AS p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC

question: 查询今年各商品的总销量
expected_result_notes: 每个商品一行，销量为明细数量之和。
golden_sql: SELECT p.name AS product, SUM(oi.quantity) AS quantity FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN analytics.demo_products AS p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC

question: 查询今年每个区域销售额最高的商品类别
expected_result_notes: 每个区域一行，取该区域销售额最高的类别。
golden_sql: SELECT region, category, sales FROM (SELECT r.name AS region, p.category AS category, SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.name ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC) AS rn FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_regions AS r ON r.id = o.region_id JOIN analytics.demo_products AS p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY r.name, p.category) AS ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY sales DESC

question: 查询今年华东区域销售额的环比增长率
expected_result_notes: 按月返回销售额和相对上月的增长率。
golden_sql: SELECT month, sales, ROUND((sales - LAG(sales) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / NULLIF(LAG(sales) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0), 4) AS growth FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR(o.created_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_regions AS r ON r.id = o.region_id WHERE r.name = '华东' AND o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(o.created_at, 'YYYY-MM')) AS monthly ORDER BY month

question: 查询今年状态为已发货的订单数

golden_sql: SELECT o.id FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)

question: 查询今年各区域的平均订单金额
expected_result_notes: 每个区域一行，按平均金额降序。
golden_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, AVG(o.total_amount) AS average_order FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_regions AS r ON r.id = o.region_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY AVG(o.total_amount) DESC

question: 查询最近 90 天各区域的销售额
expected_result_notes: 最近 90 天每个区域一行。
golden_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_regions AS r ON r.id = o.region_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC

question: 查询今年各商品类别的销量
expected_result_notes: 每个商品类别一行，销量为明细数量之和。
golden_sql: SELECT p.category AS category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS quantity FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN analytics.demo_products AS p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC

question: 查询今年销售额最高的前 10 个商品
expected_result_notes: 最多 10 行，按销售额降序。
golden_sql: SELECT p.name AS product, SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_products AS p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC LIMIT 10

question: 查询今年各区域销售额占全国的比例
expected_result_notes: 每个区域一行，占比之和为 100。
golden_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount) * 100.0 / SUM(SUM(o.total_amount)) OVER (), 2) AS share FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_regions AS r ON r.id = o.region_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC

question: 查询今年金额大于 1000 的订单数量
expected_result_notes: 只统计金额大于 1000 的有效订单。
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.total_amount > 1000 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)

question: 统计今年每月各状态的订单数
expected_result_notes: 按月、按状态返回订单数。
golden_sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(o.created_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, o.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(o.created_at, 'YYYY-MM'), o.status ORDER BY TO_CHAR(o.created_at, 'YYYY-MM'), o.status

question: 查询今年华东区域各商品类别的销售额
expected_result_notes: 只返回华东区域，按商品类别汇总。
golden_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, p.category AS category, SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_regions AS r ON r.id = o.region_id JOIN analytics.demo_products AS p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE r.name = '华东' AND o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY r.name, p.category ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC

question: 查询今年截至当前各月的累计销售额
expected_result_notes: 按月返回当月及之前的累计销售额。
golden_sql: SELECT month, SUM(sales) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS cumulative_sales FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR(o.created_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(o.created_at, 'YYYY-MM')) AS monthly ORDER BY month

question: 查询今年订单总数
expected_result_notes: 返回一个总订单数。
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)

question: 查询今年每个商品类别内销售额排名前 3 的商品
expected_result_notes: 每个类别最多 3 行，按类别内销售额排名。
golden_sql: SELECT category, product, sales FROM (SELECT p.category AS category, p.name AS product, SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC) AS rn FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_products AS p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY p.category, p.name) AS ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY category, sales DESC
